item.title: [7.2] Bitcoin rebounds to $82,000 after briefly falling below $80,000 as inflation fears trigger $950 million in liquidations
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Bitcoin recovered above $82,000 after briefly falling below $80,000 as hotter-than-expected US producer inflation intensified concerns over Federal Reserve rate hikes. Nearly $950 million in leveraged positions were liquidated, while spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $261 million in outflows.

WHY IT MATTERS

The severe liquidations and institutional ETF outflows indicate broader risk-off sentiment tied to macroeconomic inflation data that impacts wider market correlations.

item.title: [7.0] BoE's Bailey says energy price pass-through remains limited, rate risks persist
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said rising energy prices have had limited broader inflationary effects so far, but warned that second-round pressures remain uncertain. With inflation at 3.1%, above the 2% target, policymakers are weighing potential interest rate hikes against economic resilience, rising borrowing costs and geopolitical uncertainty.

WHY IT MATTERS
